title: A carbonyl within a chain
hook: Inspect the bonds and identify the functional group.

knows: Lines in a structural formula represent chemical bonds.
doesNotKnow: A ketone has a carbonyl carbon bonded to two carbon groups. In propanone the carbonyl is between two CH₃ groups.

misconception: Every molecule with the same element contains the same functional group.
objective: Recognize the stated functional group from condensed structural connectivity.

claims.text: Question, structure and explanation: Which listed functional group best describes the distinctive group in this condensed structural diagram? This diagram represents propanone. A ketone has a carbonyl carbon bonded to two carbon groups. In propanone the carbonyl is between two CH₃ groups. Lines show bonds; grouped labels such as CH₃ are condensed notation.
The diagram is a condensed 2D structural representation, not a model of molecular geometry.
